subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to docs/help for the existing TUI newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a public configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J newline support, but the remaining configurable behavior would add a new user-facing preference surface that repository policy treats as product-sensitive.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Add TUI docs and `/help` coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior without adding config now.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Expose a tested OpenClaw-owned bridge into pi-tui keybindings after choosing the CLI/config owner and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Close As Satisfied
options.body: Treat the dependency-backed newline behavior as enough and leave docs/config follow-up out of scope.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Add TUI docs and `/help` coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior without adding config now.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest observed combination of prior review context and recent TUI/docs history for this decision.
